import pandas as pd,numpy as np

def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
e=est(w); rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
grp=[(g,l,x.r.values) for (g,l),x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
bs=[]
for i in range(4000):
  m={}
  for g,l,v in grp: m[(g,l)]=rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean()
  gs=set(g for g,_,_ in grp); bs.append(np.mean([m[(g,True)]-m[(g,False)] for g in gs]))
print(e,np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc, est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o, est(w[w.origin==o]))

print('ed1',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean().round(3).to_dict())
ids=p[p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))].merge(w[['work_id','year']],on='work_id')
print(len(ids));print(ids.sort_values('year')[['passage_id','year','technology_named','confidence']].iloc[[0,1,2,-3,-2,-1]])
